chunks: Among them is a section which distorts in reading the Scripture in a way that though it sounds like the Scripture, in fact it is not; yet they say it is from God, when they know it is not; and they lie about God, and knowingly.

key_terms.لِتَحْسَبُوهُ: so that you might think it

ai.seo_question: Who are the people that distort the Scripture by making it appear authentic while it is not?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the phenomenon of *tahrif* (distortion) not merely as textual alteration but as rhetorical manipulation by the *Ulama* of the Book, who recited their own interpretations alongside the divine text to deceive the masses. It underscores the distinction between the authentic revelation and human additions, serving as a critical criterion for evaluating religious authority and the authenticity of transmitted knowledge.
